observations.body: Euodia and Syntyche are urged toward one mind with help. Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved. Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
